caption:
One star group spans 4,000 light-years. Its stars are young.

This is Andromeda, seen in ultraviolet. It is 2.5 million light-years away.
NGC 206 is a group of bright blue stars. The youngest big ones are under 10 million years old.
It is much bigger than young star clusters in our own galaxy.

What the astronomers say: NGC 206 is a stellar association, a young family of bright blue stars.
